verdict.rationale: Xero publishes an official MCP server in its own XeroAPI GitHub org that bridges MCP to Xero's API, covering contacts, chart of accounts and invoices. Its developer portal lists the MCP Server in its AI Toolkit, and a probe confirms a dedicated MCP server documentation page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and evidence of the connection and auth setup steps.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: This is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation for Xero. It provides a bridge between the MCP protocol and Xero's API, allowing for standardized access to Xero's accounting and business features.
Get Started with Xero's AI Toolkit including OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP Server, LangChain and prompt examples.
Contact management - Chart of Accounts management - Invoice creation and management - MCP protocol compliance
